verdict.line: You lose trades before level 6 if you auto into an up Riposte or get caught outside Mist on her Q-R all-in; you win from roughly level 12 once Snip Snip!'s cooldown and E's on-hit procs out-pace her Duelist healing.

brief.thesis: Gwen's Q only reaches 450 range and her E dash is 400, so she has to walk inside Fiora's 600-range Lunge and 750-range Riposte just to start a trade. Fiora's passive sustain and reflect punish that approach early, which is why the measured win rate sits at 46.7% over 863 games with Fiora favoured for both lane and solo kills. The matchup flips once Gwen's Q cooldown drops toward 3.5s and her E refund loop lets her stack A Thousand Cuts faster than Fiora can heal through it.

theirWindow.what: She can parry an E-empowered auto for a full magic-damage reflect, then Lunge in and threaten Blade Waltz before you can react. Hold all autos and stay behind minions until you've confirmed Riposte is down.

yourWindow.when: Both Lunge charges spent, Riposte down
yourWindow.what: Walk up and chain Q snips, then land an E dash-empowered auto; she has no parry and no gap-close for several seconds, so the trade is free.

start.item: Doran's Ring, Health Potion, Health Potion
start.why: Run in 85.6% of games at 46.2% win; the extra healing from two potions is what lets you survive forced early trades where Fiora's Duelist passive out-sustains you.

boots.why: Taken in 56.2% of games at 47.8% win; cuts the repeated auto damage from her Lunge pokes and Burst of Speed attack-speed windows.

core.why: First item on the 53.9%-win path; gives the mana and ability haste that shrinks Q's cooldown toward its 3.5s floor sooner.
Second item on that same path; the bonus magic damage spikes the burst your Q/E combo already applies through her passive healing.
Closes out the 53.9%-win build; by level 16-18 this is what lets your snips outright out-damage her sustain in extended fights.

situational.when: she is ahead and threatening to one-shot you with a landed Blade Waltz
her Duelist stacks are keeping her alive through every trade you win
she is building armor early and Plated Steelcaps stops paying off

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacking adaptive force and self-healing over an extended trade directly answers Duelist; the longer the fight runs, the less her sustain advantage matters.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 62.8% of games at 46.4% win; Ignite's healing reduction directly cuts into her Duelist sustain during trades. Exhaust+Flash (47.1% win, lower sample) is the pick instead if you'd rather blunt her Q-R all-in than win the poke war.

playing.title: Respect her longer threat range
playing.detail: Fiora's Lunge reaches 600 and Riposte 750, both past your 450-range Q; don't walk into those ranges unless you're committing to the trade.

playing.title: Mist before she commits
playing.detail: Pop W (Hallowed Mist) the instant she dashes in post-6; outside the mist she physically cannot target you with the follow-up damage.

playing.title: Trade only after both Lunges are spent
playing.detail: Her Q can dash a second time for free within a couple seconds; once both charges are used she has no gap-close for several seconds, so that's your window to walk up and snip freely.

playing.title: Never auto into an up Riposte
playing.detail: Her W cooldown runs 6-10s and reflects magic damage straight back to you, including E-empowered on-hit procs; bait it with a minion auto first if you need the information.

playing.title: Fire E right after Riposte falls
playing.detail: Use Skip 'n Slash's dash-and-buff window the moment her parry is confirmed down; landing the empowered auto also partially refunds E's cooldown.

playing.title: Farm through Q, not autos
playing.detail: Snip Snip! applies true damage to the center target and stacks your passive without exposing you to a parry; lean on it for safe CS instead of trading autos.

playing.title: Play for the level 12+ turn
playing.detail: The lane is measured as defensive for a reason; concede early skirmishes if needed and bank on your Dusk and Dawn into Shadowflame timing to flip the fight.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, boots, and summoner spell rates are pulled directly from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the cooldown math and trade-window reasoning above are my own tactical read, not measured data.
